/characters/adam-ackler: Sam's rival and the story's anti-hero. 18-year-old combat Caster with one goal: kill Indrid Cold.
/characters/crowley: New Dreadlord raised by Indrid Cold. 200+ years old. No philosophy, no cosmic searching, just raw violence.
/characters/dark-caster: Masked rogue Caster in black robes and ten rings. Calm under pressure, terrifyingly skilled, and hiding a secret identity.
/characters/indrid-cold: The Mothman. 1000-year-old Evergreen Caster seeking godhood on Earth. Behind every major event in the story.
/characters/love: Love Lancelot. 1000-year-old former Headcaster stuck in the body of a five-foot frog-man. Sam's combat trainer.
/characters/m: Sam and Adam's adoptive father. A 1000-year-old Evergreen Caster who gave everything to keep his boys safe from Mothman.
/characters/rose-robinson: Sam's pen pal and closest friend. 19-year-old healer Caster doing field research on Cryptid origins.
/characters/sam-sinclair: Our hero. 18-year-old kid from Point Pleasant who wants nothing to do with magic. His eyes glow gold when he Casts.
/locations/outskirts-of-cincinnati: Loveland Castle, Sentry Hill, and the Cincinnati Convoy. Where Sam trains and fights after leaving Point Pleasant.
/locations/point-pleasant: Sam and Adam's home on the Ohio River. Protected by M's barrier for a decade, until Mothman burned it down.
/locations/salem: Salem, Massachusetts. Something ancient sleeps here. File status: REDACTED.
/locations/sleepy-hollow: Sleepy Hollow, New York. The Horseman rides again. File status: REDACTED.
/locations/unity-city: Unity City, Washington, DC. The seat of power in a shattered world. File status: REDACTED.
/world/caster-powers: Every Standard and Abstract power in the MetaZoo magic system. Voice command, death touch, Sam's Quantum ability, and more.
/world/dreadlords: The Dreadlords. Dark Evergreen Casters hidden behind the scenes, responsible for the chaos Sam faces throughout the story.
/world/magical-motifs: Cones of power, cartomancy, crystal gazing, familiars, pentagrams, the Ring of Solomon. Magical motifs used in the story.
/world/power-ranking: How strong is each character? Power levels from Sam's starting 100 to Indrid Cold's 2,500,000.
/world/real-world-artifacts: Seer Stones, the Spear of Destiny, Seven League Boots, Witch Bottles. Real-world artifacts that inspired the story.
/world/evergreen-casters: The most powerful Casters in existence. Merlin, Morgayne, Indrid Cold, King Solomon, and the ones missing from the official list.
/world/timeline: Timeline of every major event in the MetaZoo world. The Veil shatters in 2021, the Battle of NYC hits in 2031.
/codex/book-bible: The series bible. Four books, 36 chapters each. Cryptid Nation through Cryptid World. Ends where it began: Ravenswood.
/codex/keyword-index: Index of canonical names, terms, and definitions. Characters, Beasties, locations, and artifacts by chapter.
/codex/one-shots: Planned side stories. The Dreadlords meeting, Crowley's rise, Adam vs. General 10, and more. Ranked by priority.
/codex/rules: Every chapter needs 5+ Beasties, 5+ casting instances, 5+ artifacts, and names must use alliteration. Full checklist.
/codex/things-to-remember: Story threads to track: Mothman, the Veil, Love's injury, ADAM, M's Spellbook, and who Sam's dad really is.
/book/1-cryptid-nation: The Veil shatters and Mothman descends on Point Pleasant. Sam's world ends and his journey begins.
/book/2-escape-from-quimblys: Sam wakes in darkness with no sense of up or down. M is gone. Now he has to find a way out of Quimblys.
/book/3-the-battle-of-loveland-castle: Sam arrives at Loveland Castle on Sentry Hill. First real battle. Orange Eyes, Loveland Frogmen, and the warrior Love.
/book/4-golden-eyes: Sam sees their faces and hears their voices. He understands the true extent of his danger for the first time.
/book/5-a-close-encounter-of-the-slimy-k: It's not the real Mothman. But that doesn't make it less terrifying. Sam and Love face a close encounter of the slimy kind.
/book/6-crossing-the-crosswick: Sam stands at the doorway. The Squatch Poncho makes him invisible but does nothing for the cold. Time to cross the Crosswick.
/book/7-the-incredibly-amazingly-effecti: The training arc. Sam enters the P9001, the Incredibly Amazingly Effective Training Gizmo Box. (Outline)
/book/8-the-cincinnati-convoy: The group joins a convoy of humans surviving outside the ruined cities. Spirits, Witch Bottles, and the road ahead. (Outline)
